description: This PHP source file defines the PDFWrapper class within the SuiteCRM\PDF namespace. It manages PDF engines, allows adding new engines, retrieves available engines, and loads specific engine classes dynamically. The class interacts with external PDF engine classes like TCPDFEngine and LegacyMPDFEngine, and includes methods for engine selection and configuration.

classes.name: PDFWrapper
classes.description: A class that manages multiple PDF engine implementations, including dynamic loading, selection, and configuration within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: addEngine
methods.description: Adds a new PDF engine to the list of available engines with its class name, file path, and fully qualified name.

methods.name: getPDFEngine
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the default or configured PDF engine, supporting external customization.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns a list of available PDF engine class names, considering system capabilities and custom extensions.

methods.name: getDefaultEngine
methods.description: Returns the default PDF engine class name based on configuration.

methods.name: fetchEngine
methods.description: Loads and instantiates a PDF engine class based on its name, with error handling for missing or incompatible classes.

methods.name: getPDFConfig
methods.description: Retrieves PDF-related configuration options from the global $sugar_config array.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Returns the controller name from configuration, if set.
